subject: Invoice portal handshake & PO visibility questions
messages:
From: Sophia Patel <sophia@solstice.io>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts@brightpeak.com
Date: 2026-11-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding & invoice delivery options

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We (Solstice Analytics) are ready to finish vendor setup but have a couple of operational questions before we upload our onboarding packet:

- Do you prefer us to submit invoices through the Redwood supplier portal (recommended by your onboarding page) or is sending invoices to accounts@brightpeak.com via email acceptable for the first 90 days?
- When an invoice references a PO that spans multiple Redwood entities (e.g., Redwood Inc. + Redwood EU), will the portal allow us to attach multiple PO lines or a single combined invoice? We want to avoid mismatches at payment.

Attached is our completed onboarding form and a short sample CSV of the invoice rows we typically send.

Attachments (stubs): Solstice_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (1 page), sample_invoice_rows.csv (3 rows)

If portal is preferred, is there anything specific about the reference/subject line or file naming convention you want so the PO auto-match works?

Appreciate the help — we’d like to go live before month-end.

Best,
Sophia Patel
Finance Operations
Solstice Analytics
phone: +1 (415) 555-0183

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Sophia Patel <sophia@solstice.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-14T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & invoice delivery options

Hi Sophia — thanks for the form and sample rows. Quick answers and a couple of asks so we can validate with AP: 

1) Channel preference: portal-first. We prefer suppliers to use the portal because it preserves metadata (PO id, entity code, line items) and triggers automated acknowledgements. Email to accounts@brightpeak.com is supported as a temporary backstop, but it creates more manual work and longer ack/payment cycles.

2) Multi-entity POs: the portal supports multi-entity POs but it depends on how the PO is formatted. For multi-entity POs, please include an additional column in your CSV called "entity_code" (example values: RD-US, RD-EU). That allows our matching to place each line against the right ledger. If you keep a single combined pdf without entity markers our AP team will have to split it manually.

3) File naming / subject: portal uploads should follow: Redwood_PO-<PONUMBER>_Sup-<VENDOR_SHORTNAME>_YYYYMMDD.csv (e.g., Redwood_PO-12345_Sup-SOLST_20261110.csv). For email fallback, put the PO number in the subject exactly as above and attach the same CSV.

4) Timing: if you go portal-first we can auto-ack within 5 minutes and preserve the webhook for ledger posting. If email, ack may be 24–72 hours.

Next steps for us: Monica, Jordan — can you confirm the entity_code mapping table below is complete for Solstice? I pulled RD-US and RD-EU but I want to make sure we capture the intercompany routing.

Monica / Jordan: please advise on the entity codes and any additional minimum header fields (tax id, remit address) we should enforce in the portal before activation.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Ops (Redwood Inference)
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Sophia Patel <sophia@solstice.io>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-14T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & invoice delivery options

Thanks Aditya / Sophia — copying the minimums from AP: 

Required CSV headers for portal uploads (must be exact): po_number, line_number, description, quantity, unit_price, currency, tax_rate, total_amount, entity_code, vendor_remit_id, vendor_tax_id, invoice_date, invoice_number

Entity codes for Solstice:
- RD-US -> Redwood, Inc. (US payments)
- RD-EU -> Redwood EU Ltd. (EU payments; Euro bank)

A few clarifications:
- vendor_remit_id is the vendor identifier we assign during onboarding (we'll supply a value once the onboarding form is processed). For now, please include your internal vendor id in that column.
- If you have multiple POs on the same invoice, include a separate row per PO line and populate the po_number column for each row. 
- Please include a remit address and VAT/tax id in the onboarding PDF (we need both for EU invoices).

Sophia — we can put you in a short pilot to test portal upload and webhook delivery. If that looks good we’ll flip the account to portal-only after 2 successful test invoices.

Monica Patel
AP Operations Manager (Redwood Inference)
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Sophia Patel <sophia@solstice.io>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-14T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & invoice delivery options

Great — thank you both. 

We will:
- Update our CSV to include the exact headers you listed.
- Add entity_code on each row and include separate rows per PO line.
- Add remit address and VAT/tax id to the onboarding PDF and re-upload.

We can start the pilot this week. Is there a preferred time window for a 15-minute test when Solstice uploads a test invoice and Redwood confirms webhook receipt? Jordan, can you coordinate a slot and share the portal sandbox upload link?

Attachments: sample_invoice_rows.csv (updated)

Best,
Sophia Patel

Solstice Analytics
